newsitem.title: JAPAN: Finland's FEK launches 5.0% yen/$US samurai bonds.
newsitem.headline: Finland's FEK launches 5.0% yen/$US samurai bonds.

text.p: Finnish Export Credit Ltd (FEK) on Thursday launched 25 billion yen worth of 5.0 percent yen/dollar dual currency samurai bonds due on February 3, 2000, lead manager Daiwa Securities said.
The bonds are priced at par.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in dollars. Holders of the samurai bonds will receive $4,470.28 for each 500,000-yen bond held at maturity.
AMT 25 bln yen COUPON 5.0 pct MATURITY Feb 3, 2000
TYPE yen/$US samurai ISS PRICE par PAY DATE Nov 8, 1996
LEAD TRUSTEE Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan
NOTES: Syndicate members are Daiwa Securities, Nikko Securities, Nomura Securities, Yamaichi Securities and Universal Securities
